cohort: Singletons delivered between 36 and 42 weeks' gestation in the Netherlands between 1999 and 2007, excluding those with hypertension, preeclampsia, diabetes, congenital anomalies, or noncephalic presentation
finding: For SGA fetuses <5th percentile, delivery at 38-39 weeks is associated with the best perinatal outcome, while for non-SGA fetuses, delivery at 39-40 weeks is optimal.
